# Ines Barrow

Circulation supervisor for the network, based at Pinecrest. Ines sets the loan periods, hold limits, and card block rules that every branch desk follows, and she trains new desk staff.

She proposed the summer pilot at Pinecrest and wrote up the [[Pilot results - Pinecrest no-charge summer]]. After the board ended [[Clearwater Resolution|overdue fines]], she ran the account cleanup, and she still handles patron questions about old balances.
